description: The camera sled must be positioned 0.5-1.5 meters above the seafloor.
context_quote: The video sled was deployed from a side-oriented A-frame by the Alpine Ocean crew and lowered until positioned 0.5-1.5 meters (m) above the seafloor.

description: Vessel speed must be kept to 1 knot or lower and never exceed 3 knots.
context_quote: Vessel speed was usually kept to 1 knot or lower and never exceeded 3 knots.

description: Parallel-mounted lasers on the camera sled must be 7.5 centimeters apart.
context_quote: The camera sled was equipped with an altimeter to record distance above sea floor, temperature probe, parallel-mounted lasers 7.5 centimeters (cm) apart, and a cable that transmitted real-time viewing of images to the vessel.

description: A 500-μm sieve must be used for sample processing.
context_quote: After collection, the “A” sample was then photographed and described more thoroughly (grain size and characteristics at depth) and both samples were then loaded onto a processing table and material washed through a 500-μm sieve using seawater under gentle pressure.

description: A four-inch diameter lexan tube must be used to remove sediment cores.
context_quote: A four-inch diameter lexan tube was inserted and sediment cores were removed from each side of the grab sampler bucket and placed in sieving buckets.

description: A 100-mL sample must be taken for grain size analysis.
context_quote: A 100-mL sample was taken from the sediment surrounding the cores on both sides and placed in plastic bags for grain size analysis.
